data.process: hourly GBM, sigma 1% per hour, one 6-hour outage per 7-day window

inputs.estimator: sample std (ddof=1) of hourly log returns

metric: relative bias of realised vol vs true sigma
verdict_rule: supports if ffill bias < -2 SE and ffill minus gap-aware < -2 SE (paired)
summary: forward-fill bias -0.33% (SE 0.19%) vs gap-aware -0.18% (SE 0.17%); paired difference -0.15% (SE 0.08%)
